gaps: Borrowing interest rates are not disclosed in any report (the 已逾期短期借款 template's 借款利率 column is blank because nothing is overdue). No lender, term, or rate is given for the 30,000,000 credit long-term loan drawn in 2025H1 or the 110,677,420 short-term credit loan drawn in 2026H1. No numeric lease discount rate is disclosed either.
The short-term borrowing notes use only these categories: 信用借款, 国内信用证借款, 应付利息, 未终止确认的已贴现未到期票据. No 保证, 质押 or 抵押 categories are disclosed.

交易性金融资产 notes show only '理财产品' and are not split into 银行理财 and 结构性存款. The only split is 银行理财产品 vs 其他类, in 万元, in the 委托理财 tables. For FY2025 and 2026H1 those tables give balances only, with no 发生额 and no funding-source split.
一年内到期的非流动资产 is blank on the consolidated balance sheet in FY2022-FY2025, 2025H1 and 2026H1. The notes contain no 一年内到期 CD reclassification.
The FY2022 amount of 到期日超过3个月的大额存单及定期存款本息 is not disclosed (the FY2023 AR gives only the year-end FY2023 figure).

FY2021 dividend: 每10股派息 and 股本基数 are not stated in the supplied reports. The FY2023 AR shows a 2022 appropriation of 613,279,158.72, which equals 1,916,497,371 × 0.32 exactly, so the implied rate is 3.20元/10股 (inferred, flagged as such). FY2021/FY2022 可分配利润 and plan-basis payout ratios are not disclosed. Computed ratios are 30.50% and 31.84%, using FY2021 归母净利润 2,010,811,421.49 and FY2022 1,504,705,950.90 from the FY2023 AR 主要会计数据. The FY2023 plan-basis ratio of 33.94% IS disclosed in the FY2023 AR, so it was wrongly listed as missing.
The cash-flow statement gives only the combined line '分配股利、利润或偿付利息支付的现金'. Dividends paid are not disclosed separately from interest paid.
2026 interim dividend: none. The 2026H1 report states 公司计划半年度不派发现金红利. The 2025H1 report likewise has no 2025 interim dividend.

2026 buyback 第一期: only share count (8,547,300) and amount excluding fees (894,661,561.03) are disclosed. Highest and lowest price, amount including fees and % of share capital are not. 2026 第二期 has no executed amounts (in progress as of the report date). These buybacks happened after 2026-06-30, so the 2026H1 库存股 balance excludes them.

H-share (2026H1 report): gross proceeds, net proceeds, underwriting and listing fees, HKD/RMB conversion and use-of-proceeds percentages are NOT disclosed. The only use-of-proceeds text is qualitative: 境外新建扩建项目及自动化建设、技术迭代与材料创新，以及补充运营资金. The issuance happened after the 2026-06-30 balance-sheet date, so 股本 at 2026H1 is still 1,916,497,371 and there is no H-share proceeds cash flow in 2026H1.

No quantitative interest-rate or FX sensitivity analysis is disclosed. The 市场风险 sections in FY2023-FY2025 AR and the H1 reports are qualitative only, and no hedging is applied. A mechanical FX net-exposure / 1% sensitivity is provided in fx_net_exposure_sensitivity (derived), and treasury-yield / net-cash bases in treasury_yields and treasury_pool_net_cash (derived).
'筹资活动产生的各项负债变动情况' (debt roll-forward table) is marked 不适用 in every report. Roll-forwards in this extract are rebuilt from CF lines and notes only as a check.
No capitalised borrowing costs are disclosed (policy text only).
2025H1 long-term borrowing note shows 信用借款 29,950,000.00 net, with no separate 一年内到期 line. The 50,000 current portion appears only in the 一年内到期的非流动负债 note and the liquidity table.

The 2021 A-share placement's share count and issue price are not restated in these reports. Only 募集资金总额 390,000.00万元 and 净额 387,981.17万元 are given. FY2023 AR's proceeds table has no 使用比例 column (computed 49,331.77/387,981.17 = 12.72%, not inserted).

Cash-flow split of interest paid vs dividends paid is not disclosed. The dividend_appropriations_by_period table has a derived interest-paid row, computed as CF line − dividends − minority dividends: FY2023 10.81m, FY2024 17.04m, FY2025 0.31m, 2026H1 0.85m. This is much lower than 利息费用 because 利息费用 includes discount interest on discounted bills, which is not paid through this line.
The treasury-yield table uses only opening and closing balances. The reports do not disclose average balances or the CD/time-deposit interest rates.

The H-share offering expenses are not disclosed in total. Only the cash paid (FY2025 11,573,946.26; 2026H1 6,625,831.73) and the capitalised prepaid listing costs in 其他流动资产 (FY2025 10,201,078.92; 2026H1 15,360,513.52) are shown. The HKD gross proceeds (HK$8,046,186,360 at HK$100.30 × 80,221,200) are derived, not disclosed.
policies: Cash equivalents: 大额存单 and 定期存款 whose maturity exceeds 3 months stay in 货币资金 but are excluded from 现金及现金等价物. Those with maturity over 1 year are classified in 其他非流动资产 as '到期日一年以上的定期存款及大额存单'. Source: 货币资金 note *1 and 其他非流动资产 note in every report.
交易性金融资产 are 理财产品 measured at FVTPL. Fair-value changes go to 公允价值变动收益 and realised returns go to 投资收益-理财收益. Source: notes 七、2 / 七、46-49 in each report.

Lease discount rate: the 租赁内含利率 is used, or the 增量借款利率 when the implicit rate cannot be determined. Interest is recognised at a fixed periodic rate. Source: FY2024 AR 五、租赁 (line ~7043); FY2025 AR (line ~6094); 2025H1/2026H1 same wording.
Borrowing-cost capitalisation: the rate for general borrowings is the weighted-average borrowing rate. This is policy text only. Source: FY2023 AR line ~6281; FY2025 AR line ~5893.

Share buyback accounting: repurchased shares are carried as 库存股 at cost. On cancellation, the difference between par value and cost reduces 资本公积, then retained earnings. Source: 2026H1 report 五、31 股份回购.

Market risk: interest-rate risk mainly comes from bank borrowings. FX risk relates to foreign-currency financial assets and liabilities, managed by buying and selling FX at appropriate times. No listed equity investments are held and no hedge accounting is used. Source: FY2025 AR 十二、3; 2026H1 十二、1(3).
Dividend practice: since listing, each year's cash dividend has exceeded 30% of attributable net profit, and cumulative dividends are about 48.03亿元. Source: FY2025 AR '质量回报双提升' section (line ~1120).

Accounting basis: from the 2026 interim report onward the company reports under Chinese Accounting Standards only (board resolution 2026-07-20, following the H-share listing). Source: 2026H1 十七、资产负债表日后事项.

2021 A-share placement projects (2026H1 report): 高容量系列MLCC扩产项目 has a committed amount of 375,000.00万, adjusted to 372,981.17万. Its cumulative spend is 186,149.22万 (49.91%), and its completion date was extended from 2025-05-10 to 2027-05-31. 深圳三环研发基地建设项目 has a commitment of 15,000.00万 and spend of 14,567.44万 (97.12%).
